Check the analysis dataset

pk_check.Rd

Runs a set of data checks and returns the findings as a tibble: required columns (ID, TIME, DV, EVID, AMT; a missing column is an error and stops the remaining checks), non-numeric or missing values, duplicated records, time order, observations before the first dose, subjects without observations, non-positive concentrations, and missing or out-of-range covariates (ranges from the covariate dictionary, see pk_covariates()).

Usage

pk_check(data = NULL, proj = NULL)

Arguments

data

Data frame. Defaults to the registered dataset.

proj

A pk_project object. Defaults to the current project.

Value

A tibble with the columns check, severity ("error", "warning" or "info"), n and detail. A tibble with zero rows means that no problem was found.

Examples

d <- tibble::tribble(
  ~ID, ~TIME, ~DV , ~AMT, ~EVID,
  1  , 0    , NA  , 100 , 1    ,
  1  , 1    , 2.5 , 0   , 0    ,
  1  , 2    , 1.9 , 0   , 0
)
pk_check(as.data.frame(d))
#> # A tibble: 0 × 4
#> # ℹ 4 variables: check <chr>, severity <chr>, n <int>, detail <chr>
